mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm really glad you're here. Have you ever wondered what it takes to turn a wild idea into reality, or how some people manage to build something the world has never seen before? That’s exactly the adventure we’re about to embark on together, inspired by Peter Thiel’s Zero to One: Notes on Startups, or How to Build the Future. Instead of just tweaking what's already out there, Thiel challenges us to think bigger—to leap from zero to one, making bold breakthroughs that reshape entire industries. Along the way, we’ll dig into questions about competition, uncover hidden opportunities, and explore the mindset that helps true innovators spot potential where others see only roadblocks. We’ll pull back the curtain on what separates lasting, game-changing startups from those simply following the crowd. You’ll discover how powerful original thinking can be, why secrets matter in business, and how the right vision and strategy can help you build something that truly stands out. So, if you’re curious about what it really takes to shape the future—and ready to look beyond imitation—let’s explore these ideas together. This journey promises to be eye-opening, inspiring, and maybe even a little bit daring. Are you ready? Let’s dive in.
